{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve top, hip length, ivory #F2EDE4, fine merino wool
Sweater: slim fine-gauge turtleneck, hip length, forest green #2F4A3F, merino-wool blend
Trousers: straight-leg, high waist, full length to the ankle, charcoal #3A3D42, lined wool-blend flannel
Coat: hooded, below-knee, straight cut, navy #1F2A3C, down-insulated wool-blend shell with a water-repellent finish
Socks: thick crew socks, heather grey #6B6E73, merino wool
Boots: ankle boots with a block heel and a deep rubber lug sole, black #1A1A1A, waterproof treated leather
Scarf: wide, long, wrapped at the neck, camel #B58B5A, soft wool
Hat: close-fitting beanie, charcoal #4A4D52, merino wool with a fleece lining
Gloves: wrist length, black #1A1A1A, leather with a warm lining
Bag: structured medium tote with a top zip, black #1A1A1A, water-resistant coated fabric

This outfit keeps the neat business look of a refined knit, tailored trousers and ankle boots, while the layers underneath and the insulated coat handle deep frost on a 20-minute walk. The waterproof leather boots with a rubber sole grip on snow and resist road salt, and the full-length trousers keep the salt spray off your socks. The scarf, hat and gloves protect the areas that lose heat fastest, and they come off easily once you reach the office. The deep green, navy and charcoal palette hides slush and salt marks and looks polished at your desk."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2253,"output_tokens":1190},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
